statement: Pinned Cemu includes six-byte MotionPlus raw value and slow-flag extraction in its 0x37 Core+Accel+IR+Extension data path; the reviewed code currently retains raw orientation values and comments out application of a MotionPlus calibration transform. It reads eight bytes of base accelerometer calibration and sixteen bytes for Nunchuk/Classic extensions, with incomplete MotionPlus calibration handling. Because its MotionPlus state and extension variant are separate and report-mode logic is extension/IR dependent, whether this decoder actually reaches live gyro for the surveyed profile is not established by source alone; it requires a Cemu host test.

applicability.revision: Pinned software consumer; retail Wii Remote revision not measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer; Cemu 29f2f1f; provider.cpp 302-323, 378-430, 470-549, 1015-1048; WiimoteMessages.h 200-230. Do not claim calibrated rad/s, checksum verification or a successful gyro test.
